shown_summary_markdown:
Les deux animations sont validées :)

Je propose **+5 % de dégâts directs par rang** pour l’attaque sournoise :

- Rang 1 : **+5 %**
- Rang 10 : **+50 %**
- Rang 11 : **+55 %**
- Rang 12 : **+60 %**

Le bonus concerne les **armes et les sorts**. L’attaque bénéficie du bonus et met fin à la furtivité.

Furtivité devient donc montable jusqu’à **10 rangs appris**, avec les bonus d’équipement au-delà.
accepted_attack_scope: Weapons and spells: the attack initiated while stealth is active receives its direct damage bonus and ends stealth.
accepted_ranked_purchase_direction: Replaces unique once-only SF00 purchase with a ranked active; existing common one-point-per-rank learning rules remain.
copy_approval: Shown summary explicitly accepted; previous RP remains accepted. The full consolidated tooltip in the prepared card was not re-shown and is not newly approved by inference.
visual_scope: Camouflage and movement economy already accepted separately under ANIM-S28-ACCEPT01. No new bonus attack animation is shown by this response.
unshown_mechanical_cases: exact multiplication/addition order with other damage bonuses and criticals
native bursts/multiple projectiles/areas and per-component snapshot
channelled attacks and delayed direct impacts
rejected attacks without resource or valid target
equipment rank changes during a pending attack
